intro: Transparent self-pay pricing with no insurance authorizations and no surprise billing. Payment is due at the time of service.

visits.name: New Patient Visit
visits.description: Your first comprehensive visit — history, assessment, and a care plan built around you.

visits.name: Follow-Up Visit
visits.description: Ongoing care, chronic condition follow-up, and treatment adjustments.

visits.name: Lab Review Visit
visits.description: Review recent laboratory results together and plan appropriate next steps.

visits.name: Medication Refill Visit
visits.description: Medication review and refills when safe and clinically appropriate.

notes: Premier Wellness Telehealth is a self-pay practice and does not bill or accept health insurance.
Laboratory testing, imaging, medications, and services provided by outside facilities are not included in the visit fee.
Patients may request documentation of their visit for personal records; reimbursement by an insurance plan is not guaranteed.
